rationale: KDoc is multiline_comment in tree-sitter-kotlin. The docstring must attach to add() - this pins the M14.1 KDoc fix (previously looked for nonexistent node type 'comment'). M37 KAD2 adds the adjacency pins: the second declaration carries its OWN doc, and the third (doc-less) carries none — the pre-KAD2 forward scan ran past the declaration (dead `===` identity) and leaked the first doc onto every sibling.
